fields.finding: Kapton includes 0.1 kg of unconditioned seals/titanium-surface release inventory in RESULTS, but INPUTS has no scalar for it. At the reference 10% retained fraction this contributes 0.01 kg to the 1.0249312800972046 kg residual inventory. The full-area AF bond also uses 1250 kg/m3 in the solid-volume reconstruction although INPUTS names that density only for scarf adhesive; 019/021b carry the same generic adhesive-density assumption. These are reconstructed assumptions, not measured material properties.
fields.proposed_next: Add named inputs for Kapton residual seals/surface inventory and AF bond density, with provenance and service-data tags. RECONSTRUCTION-ASSUMPTIONS.json makes both explicit here.
